title: Prague in February: The Off-Season Is the Real Season
description: Charles Bridge at 8am with eleven people on it instead of eleven hundred, svíčková in a pub with no English menu, and a castle you can actually hear yourself think in. Why winter Prague beats summer Prague on every axis except temperature, and how to do three days there on a weekend-flight budget.

comments.comment: The 8am Charles Bridge tip is gold. Add Vyšehrad if you go back — same views, no crowds even in July.
